purpose: Reusable source-scoped unit metrics with typed denominators and explicit temporal/attribution warnings; not a comprehensive unit census
criticalRules: Aircraft on hand, inoperative aircraft, potentially operational aircraft, organizational allowance and serviceable aircraft are DIFFERENT metrics.
Reported credited enemy aircraft are claims, NOT independently verified enemy losses.
Unit combat sorties, group missions, and bomber losses observed during escort are DIFFERENT denominators.
A Czech flight within a British RAF squadron is not an additional national squadron; do not add to whole-RAF totals.
Finnish squadron-linked death records include all reported categories and job types, NOT pilot losses.
Belgian peacetime staff bases and alternate wartime deployment bases conflict; none is a verified wartime point.
Soviet regiment airfield names can contain multiple sites; do not duplicate aircraft strength over each site.
Dates covering 1945 may include events after European VE Day; filter only with actual event dates, not assumed full-year totals.
